tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Search the official MCP Registry for servers that provide a capability your current tools lack. Describe the capability in a few words. Do not include prompts, user data, or secrets. Results are registry listings; ResolveMesh has not tested or approved them.

tools.name: compatibility_lookup
tools.description: Return the source-backed ResolveMesh compatibility result for one allowlisted client and hosted-tool pair.

tools.name: compatibility_changes
tools.description: Return cursor-paginated, approved ResolveMesh compatibility events using the same allowlisted filters as the public JSON API.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "find_tool" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
